reasoning: Every schedule with <=14 changed machine orders is extended to one of the 38,760 size-14 release masks. Every such mask preserves all machine orders in at least one independently verified UNSAT core. Contradiction at Cmax<=2005.
provenance: Machine cores were selected from two earlier oracle runs, but each selected core was independently rebuilt with unconditional job and resource precedence and NoOverlap before inclusion in the proof.
scope: Incumbent-relative distance only; not global optimum makespan.
